title: Candidate-sampling fidelity probe and adaptive threshold synthesizer for AWQ/GPTQ profiles
creator: Elena Park
description: Background: We frequently ship quantized model variants (AWQ/GPTQ, int8/int4) and rely on thresholds to gate rollout. Current checks are heavy-weight whole-batch evaluations or static heuristics that either miss subtle semantic regressions or trigger too many false positives. Goal: implement a lightweight candidate-sampling fidelity probe that runs in pre-rollout and ongoing canary windows to quickly surface semantic drift introduced by quant profiles and automatically synthesize conservative acceptance thresholds based on per-cohort signal-to-noise.
steps: Define candidate-sampling strategy: sample 10% of production-like requests per route across 4 cohorts (short prompts, long prompts, instruction-heavy, code)
Instrument lightweight semantic tests: embedding cosine drift, normalized edit distance on canonical prompts, and task-specific metric stubs (e.g., pass@k heuristic for code)
Implement noise model for AWQ/GPTQ variants using synthetic perturbation to calibrate expected distribution under compression
Build threshold synthesizer: compute per-cohort baseline variance and recommend threshold at baseline + k * sigma (k configurable; start at 3)
Add rolling-window drift detection and automatic temporary rollback trigger when multiple cohorts exceed thresholds
Integrate with Console: per-route probe dashboard, alerting (PagerDuty/Slack), and an API to fetch synthesized thresholds
Create runbook for on-call and release engineers: how to interpret probe signals and perform manual validation
acceptance_criteria: Probe runs in <200ms per-sample overhead when attached to streaming path
Synthesized thresholds reduce false positive rollback rate by >= 40% compared to static heuristics on our historical release set
Probe correctly flags 90%+ of regressions in the internal regression corpus (release-quant-2025) at the chosen operating point
Dashboard surfaces per-cohort deltas and a single synthesized threshold with provenance for each model profile
comments: 2026-02-21 Elena Park: Kickoff meeting notes attached to Confluence link. Agreed cohorts and initial metric set. Action: Marco to prototype sampling harness against local replay store.

2026-02-26 Marco Alvarez: Prototype completed — sampling harness + embedding cosine comparator. Initial microbenchmark shows 180ms/sample overhead on cpu worker; need to move comparator into C++ hot path to hit <200ms for streaming attach. Opening PR for prototype instrumentation.

2026-03-02 Design review (Aisha Chen): Recommended adding an instruction-following coherence metric for instruction-heavy cohort. Also suggested we avoid reliance on a single pass@k heuristic for code cohort — use a combined heuristic (token-overlap + compilation success where possible).

2026-03-04 SRE (Thomas Nguyen): Raised concern about alert noise during high-traffic spikes. Agreed to incorporate traffic-normalized z-score instead of raw delta for the alerting rule. Added to steps.

2026-03-08 Marco Alvarez: Implemented threshold synthesizer and ran sweep over release-quant-2025 dataset. Preliminary numbers: synthesized thresholds cut false positives by ~46% versus current heuristics; recall on labeled regressions 92%. Need more stress-testing on long-tail prompts.

2026-03-10 Elena Park: Retrospective sync — shipping plan adjusted: roll out probe in canary-only mode for two weeks, enable auto-rollback opt-in for Dedicated customers, and add a gating flag to disable rollback for high-risk routes. Prepare runbook before enabling auto-rollback.
